name: IFCI Limited
remarksWeb: 80723280 number of equity shares were allotted to GoI, being the Promoter, on February 28, 2025, on preferential basis. In respect of the shares allotted to GoI, the In-principal Approval & Listing Approval from the Stock Exchanges have been received on 25/02/2025 and 21/03/2025 respectively & the Trading Approval thereof was received on 03/04/2025. In view of receipt of Trading Approval from BSE & NSE on 03/04/2025, the capital was updated in the records of CDSL & NSDL thereafter. The said shares were credited into the demat account of the GoI, the allottee on 26/03/2025, accordingly, the holding of GoI has increased from 187,45,53,816 number of shares to 195,52,77,096 number of shares, which is being reflected in the shareholding pattern.

name: IFCI Limited
revisionRemark: The pre-allotment holding of the allottee i.e. Government of India (through President of India), being the Promoter is 1750576628 number of equity shares was inadvertently mentioned as the post-allotment holding in place of 1874553816.     123977188 number of equity shares were allotted to Government of India (through President of India) on April 18, 2024.    The post-allotment holding of GoI is 1874553816 number of equity shares representing 71.72% of paid up capital of the company.

name: IFCI Limited
remarksWeb: Clarification under General Info about Company: IFCI Limited is a Government Company as per the provisions of Section 2(45) of the Companies Act, 2013. Government of India holds 61.02% of the paid-up share capital of the Company.
